title: Tutti instrument
description: An orchestral instrument definition: playable range, articulations and their keyswitches, controller mapping, and General MIDI program.

range.description: Lowest and highest playable MIDI note. Notes outside are allowed but warned.

articulations.description: Supported articulations; the first is the default.

keyswitches.description: Articulation code to keyswitch note. Empty for instruments without keyswitches. Defaults start at MIDI 24 (C1) in articulation order.

dynCC.description: Controller driven by the dynamics lane. Default 1.

exprCC.description: Controller driven by the expression lane. Default 11.

speakDelayMs.description: Playback-only delay so slow-speaking sections sit behind the beat. Not applied to exported files.

program.description: General MIDI program number (0-based) written to exported files.

bank.description: Bank the instrument came from; 'orchestra' for the built-in table.

samples.description: Folder holding map.json and the sample files, relative to the bank file or absolute.

kit.description: Fixed-pitch drum kit: MIDI note to piece name. Samples play at their recorded pitch and only on mapped notes.

patch.description: Sketch-synth voice overrides: waves [[type, detuneCents, level]], a, d, s, r, level, lfo, oneShot.
